display_long_description:
Robot Company is a FREE multiplayer social VR Tag exploration game on Meta Quest, where you and friends can play tag with each other. Be untagged to save friends or tagged to make them MAGMA! With constant updates, there’s always something new to explore!
[media]

**Why Players Love Robot Company:**

Tag with friends, explore every secret, or even just splurge in shop. So many possibilities to have fun!
[media]

**Customize Your Robot:**

Come down over to the shop to splurge on cosmetics to show off who YOU are!
[media]

Play Robot Company for FREE on Meta Quest today and experience nonstop crazy chaos with friends.
